LanguageData.BWT_EnabledTip: When off, no title cards play automatically. Debug keys still work.
LanguageData.BWT_AutoPauseTip: Pauses while the camera is taken over, so nobody dies from being unseen.
LanguageData.BWT_DuckMusicTip: Music fades to silence before the title appears, then fades back.
LanguageData.BWT_OncePerBossTip: Recorded in the save file. The same boss kind never plays twice.
LanguageData.BWT_OncePerMapTip: Recorded in the save file. Re-entering the same special map does not play again.
LanguageData.BWT_OncePerBiomeTip: Recorded in the save file. Re-entering the same special biome does not play again.
LanguageData.BWT_Recorded: Recorded in this save: {0} boss kinds, {1} maps, {2} biomes
LanguageData.BWT_RecordedNone: Recorded in this save: (no save loaded)
LanguageData.BWT_ResetDone: Reset. Those cards will play again next time.
LanguageData.BWT_ResetNoSave: No save is loaded, nothing to reset.
